headline: Presidential order that sets new pay rates for certain federal workers, likely as part of the yearly federal pay update.
what_it_does: This order adjusts certain rates of pay. Orders with this title are usually issued each year to update pay tables for federal civilian employees, and often for members of the military. No summary was provided, so the exact groups covered and the size of any changes cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may be adjusted under the new pay schedules this order sets.
Their pay may be adjusted if the order covers military pay, as these yearly orders often do.
